name: command-25
description: A design-token picker that lists color tokens with swatches and hex values.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const tokens = [ { name: "primary", hex: "#4F46E5", className: "bg-indigo-600" }, { name: "success", hex: "#16A34A", className: "bg-green-600" }, { name: "warning", hex: "#D97706", className: "bg-amber-600" }, { name: "danger", hex: "#DC2626", className: "bg-red-600" }, { name: "info", hex: "#0284C7", className: "bg-sky-600" }, { name: "neutral", hex: "#52525B", className: "bg-zinc-600" }, ] export default function BrandColorTokenPicker() { const [token, setToken] = React.useState("primary") const active = tokens.find((t) => t.name === token) return (
color.{token} {active?.hex}
No token found. {tokens.map((t) => ( setToken(t.name)} > {t.name} {t.hex} ))}
) }
